what_to_detect: A static adds a card type to an object in addition to its other types: the contribution names an added type and carries no '=' token, so every prior type and subtype stays.
near_miss: A static sets the object's type outright (the contribution carries '='), replacing its prior types.

what_to_detect: A permanent with two or more card types is a legal target of a candidate whose targeting restriction names only one of them: it counts as each of its types.
near_miss: A permanent carrying none of the restriction's types is absent from the candidate's legal targets.

near_miss: A permanent carrying none of the restriction's types is absent from the candidate's legal targets.

what_to_detect: An object that is not a creature carries no creature subtypes (including changeling's all-types), so a cost or effect requiring a creature of a type finds no such object.
near_miss: A creature (or changeling creature) satisfies the same type requirement.

what_to_detect: A permanent whose card types a continuous effect changed keeps its supertypes: a legendary (or world) permanent no longer of its printed card types still counts for the legend (or world) rule in the state-based check after a resolution.
near_miss: A type-changed legendary permanent with no same-named twin under its controller stays on the battlefield.
